cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Photograph the collapsed cake before we clear it. Tomorrow's winning one needs an accurate before picture.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The oven's burnt out. You can't bake another here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then label the photograph 'equipment failure' as well. Please capture the oven display; a comeback from both will be much more impressive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbor will lend us her oven, but only from midnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Confirm the exact time and preheating, please. Keep the message with the photos. When we win, I want the judges to know we began at midnight, not after breakfast.
